name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: A segmented control whose surface slides between items, or chips that pop in with a check when pressed.

useCases: Switching a view or alignment with a segmented control, or picking several filters as chips.
limitations: Single mode keeps one item pressed once chosen. Chips wrap onto new lines; the segmented track expects one row. Icon-only detection treats any item without text children as icon-only.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give each ToggleGroupItem a unique string value, the group an aria-label, and icon-only items an aria-label. Reduced motion moves the surface and presses chips instantly.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/toggle-group.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
